records.license: Tripo Studio Pro commercial grant (paid product Studio, not API)
edits: generated by hand on Studio's HD Model tab, not through tools/studio_image_to_glb.ts. That script drives the Smart Mesh (low_poly) tab, which has no texture stage at all: its output came back with textures 0 / images 0 and in 66 open shells that could not be boolean-unioned, because only 2 of 70 pieces were volumes. HD Model is the DEFAULT tab on a cold /workspace/generate and the script actively clicks away from it

settings against this repo's budgets rather than Studio's defaults: Texture 2K (default 4K would not fit bytes_max), PBR OFF (map_vigil.gdshader is unshaded and samples one map, so metallic/roughness/normal would be three more images inside the same byte cap for nothing on screen), Polycount 6000 (default 2,000,000) against triangle_max 8000, Triangle topology, Privacy Private. Cost moved 55 -> 40 credits with those choices

one mesh, one surface, POSITION+NORMAL+TEXCOORD_0, 5615 triangles, 3824 verts, 604,608 bytes with a 2048x2048 JPEG baseColor embedded at 413,216 of them. min Y exactly 0.0 as exported, so it needed no re-grounding

two connected components by design, welded: the hall (2683 v / 5362 t, y 0.000..0.776) and the smoke above the chimney (142 v / 253 t, y 0.797..0.933). Raw index-space it counts 118, which is UV seams and not geometry -- 3824 -> 2825 verts on a weld is exactly the Euler prediction for a closed surface at 5615 triangles. The gate now welds before counting

the rose window stays absent, unchanged from the parametric version it replaces: docs/story/01-world.md grades the window becoming a mirror as L3, the single reveal point, and the foreshadow ledger's rule 2 defers anything that discloses before its tier. It is also the wrong side of the wall -- the hearth-side window faces in at the fire, and from the road you stand outside it

the export's own download never reached disk under the Chrome extension: the page builds a 604,604-byte blob with download=act1-vigil-hall.glb, but Chrome wrote nothing and a fetch to localhost hangs without resolving or rejecting. The bytes came out by handing the task id to the existing re-export path, which matched at 604,608
records.acceptance: fol2 approved the building in-engine on 2026-08-24 ("I approve this building"), having seen it seated on the Act I map at THRESHOLD_SCALE 7.0. The same message approved dropping the gate's blanket no-texture ban ("I don't think I still support that decision anymore") and the connected-component weld fix. Map LAYOUT around it — the spacing between the Vigil and the first wave of nodes — is still open.
